handoff: Approve: the change does what the story asks and nothing else. findings.title: The skill names a 'major' severity that its own findings format does not list
findings.detail:
Step 1 says 'A blocking (or major) one not fixed is a blocking finding', but the skill's JSON format (severity: blocking | minor | nit, near the end of the file) has no major. The receipt schema (packages/schema/src/receipt.ts:70) does allow major, so a reviewer reading only the skill sees a severity it cannot emit.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Leave as a note; if touched later, list major in the skill's severity line or drop '(or major)'.
